_readme: The files the clock is made of. index.html (a tiny shell that never needs editing) fetches each of these on every load, asking the server whether it changed (cache: no-cache), then runs them in this order. To add a script or stylesheet, list it here - there are no ?v= numbers to bump and nothing else to update. `shell` must match SHELL in index.html's boot script; bump both only if that script changes.
